text: The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Property Standards Committee. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and will recommend eight candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Property Standards Committee: Candidate PSC2-257 Candidate PSC2-220 Candidate PSC2-259 Candidate PSC2-197 Candidate PSC2-232 Candidate PSC2-184 Candidate PSC2-228 Candidate PSC2-227 Candidate PSC2-252 Candidate PSC2-246 Candidate PSC2-247 Candidate PSC2-229 Candidate PSC2-254 Candidate PSC2-218 Candidate PSC2-243 Candidate PSC2-209 Candidate PSC2-258 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (June 3, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.
